description: Two drivers in one session: the finisher's result goes to the other, and a winner starts the other's DNF countdown.

Driver 100 wins: the other racer hears of it and gets a DNF countdown.
A minute later the countdown runs out.
Driver 101 finishes second: driver 100 hears of it, no countdown.
Driver 101 is second, before the countdown.
The countdown runs out all the same.
